items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I never worked with the Duke’s band.

ctx.x: Him and Ellington seemed to have very different styles of leading a group from what I’ve heard.
I wouldn’t know. I never worked with the Duke’s band.
Who were some of your favorite arrangers for the Basie group at the time?
